data.body:
[P2] Preserve the terminal plugin hook for started skipped branches

A running `NestingType.FLAT` branch has already emitted `onOperationStart`. Once it is marked skipped, this return—and the equivalent failure path—bypasses its existing `fireOnOperationEnd()` call. `markSkipped()` emits no replacement, so the hook never arrives even when the branch's user code finishes. This drops the branch span entirely in `ExecutionOtelPlugin`, which creates operation spans only in `onOperationEnd`, and bypasses custom plugin cleanup. Emit the terminal hook exactly once for started skipped branches while continuing to suppress result publication, and cover both success and failure exits.
